project_type: AWS CDK TypeScript project with cdk-nag AwsSolutions checks
build_system: npm with tsc for compilation, CDK for infrastructure synthesis
test_framework: Jest with ts-jest transform, using aws-cdk-lib/assertions Template matching
verification_instructions: 1. Run 'npm run build' to compile TypeScript. 2. Run 'npm test' to run Jest unit tests. 3. Run 'npx cdk synth "**"' to validate CDK synthesis and cdk-nag checks pass.
environment_constraints: Node v22.22.3 available (project requests >=24 but works with 22). npm packages already installed.
contribution_requirements: CI runs prettier check, eslint, typecheck, and cdk-nag. All must pass.
key_patterns: Stack defined in lib/example-project-stack.ts. Uses aws-cdk-lib constructs (sqs.Queue, sns.Topic). cdk-nag AwsSolutionsChecks plugin applied in bin/example-project.ts. Tests use Template.fromStack() assertions. Validations.of().acknowledge() used to suppress specific nag rules.
directory_structure: bin/ - CDK app entry point; lib/ - stack definitions; test/ - Jest tests; .github/workflows/ - CI (build.yml)
